summary: Recorded provider SSE replay suite: 25 fixtures under tests/fixtures/sse/{chat,responses,anthropic,gemini} served verbatim over a local std TcpListener and consumed by the real OpenAiCompatibleBackend per wire; 21 tests assert the normalized ProviderEvent trace (text/reasoning deltas, tool call ids/names/args, usage, completion/failure) and the final Completion/BackendError. Known-bug variants pin current behavior with the ZE item that will flip them.
notes: Source inventory: 68 .sse files, 17 empty (frozen-input/base), 22 unique non-empty by sha256. Kept all 4 unique kill319 captures per wire for chat/anthropic/gemini (partial-master/http-response-1 duplicates tool-master/http-response-2) plus 3 representative ZS1-112 chat captures (the other 7 differ only in tool arguments). No .sse capture exists for the Responses wire; responses/zs1-117-*.sse reproduce byte-for-byte the streams emitted by the ZS1-117 stage1_host_smoke.py fixture server. variant-*.sse are one-field edits of a capture pinning current behavior: ZE-221 (chat finish_reason=length, responses incomplete/max_output_tokens, anthropic max_tokens, gemini MAX_TOKENS -> currently errors), ZE-226 (chat stop+tool_calls, anthropic unknown event, gemini totalTokenCount > sum -> currently errors), ZE-223 (anthropic dated serving model -> currently rejected). Truncated captures (no terminal frame) fail on every wire and no ToolCallDone is emitted for partial tool args. No non-test unwrap/expect/panic, unsafe or Arc<Mutex> added.
